# Paper transcriptions (hand-written, NOT generated by sync_data.py)

Source: Ismail, Audu and Tumala (2016), "Volatility forecasting with the wavelet
transformation algorithm GARCH model: Evidence from African stock markets",
The Journal of Finance and Data Science 2, 125-135, DOI 10.1016/j.jfds.2016.09.002.
Local copy: `archive/legacy_20261105/ATSA_MODWT_GARCH/papers/base_paper.pdf`.

The PDF was read with `pdftotext -layout`. Tables 10-12 come out with their row
labels misaligned, so row order was assigned using the paper's own sentences:

- Table 10 orders: taken from the text of Section 3 ("the AIC chooses ARMA(1,0) ... for Kenya ...").
  AIC values: Table 10 columns as extracted.
- Table 11: AIC order fixed by "for all countries except South Africa, the MODWT-GARCH(1,1)
  model produces lower AIC" (only the third pair, -5.48 vs -5.47, has MODWT higher).
  alpha/beta rows assigned in the same Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Tunisia order.
  The `*_plus_*` columns are sums computed by us, not printed in the paper.
  omega values are omitted because their extraction was ambiguous.
- Table 12: pairs listed as (MODWT-GARCH, GARCH); order fixed by "for all four African
  countries except Kenya, the MODWT-GARCH(1,1) model produces smaller forecasting errors".
- Table 1 extracted cleanly.

Verify against the PDF before quoting these numbers outside the app.
